steps.content: As you slowly open your eyes, an oppressive darkness surrounds you. You find yourself standing in a space that's unfamiliar, yet oddly haunting.

The walls seem to press down from all sides, shaping into a meticulously geometric triangular corridor. Though you're certain you've never set foot here, the light beckoning from the tunnel's end radiates a warmth that feels both comforting and eerily familiar.
As you move along, the narrow tunnel starts to expand. Suddenly, you find yourself flanked by sheer vertical walls. Emerging from this passageway, you're enveloped by an overwhelming darkness.
A sliver of light pierces through the rift of this void, drawing you in while something deep within warns you of its peril.
Maybe it's best not to get any closer.
Looks like you've gotten more cautious. Guess I won't have to worry as much from now on.
Shalom stands quietly behind you. You try instinctively to unleash your shackles, yet like a snuffed-out flame, nothing happens.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Give up; the power of Mania has no sway here, and that includes your shackles.
Did you use some kind of power? Is it spatial manipulation, or perhaps mental control? Is this an illusion you've conjured?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I do possess certain neuroinduction capabilities, but don't mistake this place as my creation—I've simply guided your consciousness here.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This is the Consciousness Observatorium, a realm that has been tirelessly developed by Paradeisos over years. It represents the outermost boundary where human reason can venture into the Mania.
She points toward the rift.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Beyond that rift lies the realm of primordial Mania, the origin of all things. Anything that ventures into it will instantly warp and disintegrate, while any sentient being will be swiftly overtaken, assimilated, and lose their sense of self.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You've seen the Black Ring. Should it intensify, it will ultimately forge a link to this locale. This is the cutting edge of cataclysmic studies, and undoubtedly the most perilous zone.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: That's why Paradeisos has implemented the most stringent counter-Mania protocols on this side of the rift, to ensure the malevolent forces from beyond never breach this realm.
So that's why the shackles were ineffective... You’ve abducted me to this forsaken place just to quell my spirit. What is it that you’re truly after?
She offers a resigned smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You wanted a heart-to-heart, didn't you? Naturally, I'd pick a sanctuary where you can speak your mind—a true "intimate universe" between us.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's no prying machinery or listening ears here. Only those with a unique link to the realm beyond the rift can access this place. It's solely our world now.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I am a Sinner of unique designation, tasked solely with fulfilling dire necessities. My role situates me on the frontline of turmoil, monitoring the volatile currents of Mania and the shifting landscapes of reality. I report my observations to higher authorities and offer strategies for intervention.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Alright, I've laid my cards on the table, showing you my true stance. However, I suspect that these matters may feel quite distant to you. Surely you have questions that are closer to your heart—go ahead and ask.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Personally, I'll be completely upfront about what I can discuss. And when it comes to what I can't reveal, due to certain rules, I'll be straightforward about that as well.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I trust you'll grasp the nuances between the two.
This is indeed the most honest answer Shalom has ever given.
You ponder briefly, then finally break the silence.

options: Your real reason for coming to MBCC

choices.text: Your real reason for coming to MBCC

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: A <color=#fb9259>greeting</color> that doubles as a <color=#fb9259>test</color>. The objective is to gauge the loyalty of the present Chief of MBCC.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos has been watching you; your unique abilities are vital to this city. They're considering entrusting you with an even greater responsibility.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: All the more reason to deepen mutual understanding. Before they task you with important responsibilities, they want to gauge the extent to which they can place their trust in you.
Entrusted with great responsibility... is that a form of validation? Yet, you find no joy in it. The language is cloaked in ambiguity, always hinting at an ulterior motive.
For example, what happens if you fail the test? How will you be dealt with?

options: Has the test ended? Did I pass?

choices.text: Has the test ended? Did I pass?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: We're nearly there; this is the final stretch.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So far, everything falls within acceptable bounds. Well done.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos has its own set of judgment criteria, which I'm not permitted to reveal to you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But believe me, actions of that severity would certainly be beyond what you could stomach as well.
An ambiguous answer.
What happens if I reach the level of "unacceptable"? How will I be handled?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It would be a manner of dealing with a threat to humanity that you, too, would find justifiable. Unfortunately, the specific details can't be disclosed.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Relax, ${PlayerName}. You're a person of integrity and good character. As long as you don't make an enemy of the city, you won't be regarded as a foe by Paradeisos.

She smiles—a smile with the power to melt hearts. Yet this time, it instills in you a deeply unsettling sense of dislocation. It's not the familiar facade of upper-class hypocrisy; it's an emptiness so alien, so unnatural; it's as though you're standing before a mere husk of a human.
And the likelihood that this is another layer of her deception only serves to intensify your agitation.

options: What's going on with the shackles on you?

choices.text: What's going on with the shackles on you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Though they may appear different, these are your own shackles—originating from <color=#fb9259>your past self</color>.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I am a Sinner, and you bestowed these shackles upon me on the day we first met. Do you remember?
And beyond that, I'm utterly powerless over them—I can't even sense their existence.
These enigmatic shackles feel so alien; I can neither control them nor use them to influence Shalom. I'm completely blind to their presence.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Hmm... maybe your <color=#fb9259>amnesia</color> has led to a subtle shift in your identity. Because of this, you can no longer connect with the shackles of your past, losing your grip on them as a result.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: In a sense, their hold on me has weakened considerably compared to the past. Shackles are the power of the mind, and a fragment of that power has faded along with your memories.

options: What was the old me like?

choices.text: What was the old me like?

steps.content: Who was I before I lost my memory? Why did I use the shackles on you? What happened between us?
Would he be under such tight security as well? Did he pass the test of Paradeisos?
steps.female_content: Would she be under such tight security as well? Did she pass the test of Paradeisos?

steps.content: You let out a sigh.

options: I suppose this is another one of those "off-limits" topics, huh?

choices.text: I suppose this is another one of those "off-limits" topics, huh?

steps.content: You say you're laying all your cards on the table, but every question gets a "can't be disclosed." I don't hold it against you; it's all rather futile.
In a way, making it clear what you can't disclose is a form of openness in itself. Your attitude has been transparent enough.
If that's the case, don't expect any heart-to-heart from me either. I don't bear my soul to things I can't see.
If you have nothing more to reveal, then let me go. I've got no more questions.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Ah, the old "draw back to leap forward" tactic to bait me. Clever, aren't you?
She takes a step closer to you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos has nothing to tell you, but I do.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: When I said I once considered you a friend, I meant it. If possible, I'd like to find that "friend" again.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But what good would it do to fill you in on the past?

She lifts her eyes to meet yours, sending an icy shiver up your spine. You wish to step back, but you're not just held; you're gripped by her as if bound. The temperature in the lifeless room plummets; all you can do is lock eyes with her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What if I told you that your past self was a fearsome monster—despised and shunned by the world, leaving destruction in your wake?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Would you believe me now?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What if I told you that all you hold dear is nothing but a velvet leash, skillfully crafted to control you? That the love you receive is merely a ruse to tame your spirit. They've taken what truly matters to you, replacing it with hollow substitutes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Do you have the courage to shatter this illusion?
Those doll-like eyes remain void. Yet, right here, in this very space, you're suddenly overtaken by an emotion so intense it sets your heart racing.

It's an insatiable yearning, an irresistible allure. For a fleeting moment, you plummet into an uncharted past, engulfed in an eternal darkness of solitude. Before you lies but a glimmer of light—and you wish to turn it into a spark that incinerates this world.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Once, you were a force to be reckoned with, an unyielding edge that bent to no one and broke for nothing—even willing to consume yourself to incinerate this world. But that power has long since faded in you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Do you wish to confront your true self? To reclaim <color=#fb9259>him</color>?
steps.female_content: Do you wish to confront your true self? To reclaim <color=#fb9259>her</color>?

steps.content: Of course, you hope to reclaim your past.
Yet before you can, a loathing washes over you, as if someone is tightening a noose around your neck—seeking to strip you of your autonomy and provoke an instinctual urge to resist.
Suddenly, you sense a rift in the woman's otherwise compelling "performance." Seizing the moment, you grab the hand she's using to restrain you.
Why do you want me to come back?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Because you are my friend. I want to help you.
I don't care how you see me, nor what you want to do for me.
What I'm asking is, <color=#fb9259>what do you want</color>?
Pulling her closer forcefully, you lock eyes with her to stave off the odd sense of unrest welling up inside you. You search for something real in her doll-like void of an expression.
To keep from losing yourself, you need to sharpen your resolve with clarity.
What's in it for you if I go back in time, shattering everything, only to end up bruised and broken?
What's your endgame with me? What are you trying to extract? If you've got a wish or demand, lay it on the table. Speak up, just like you forced me to be upfront with you.
You want to hold my sincerity hostage? Then offer yours first. That's what a <color=#fb9259>real conversation</color> is.

It's a momentary silence, but you seize it. That silence is her vulnerability, and within that vulnerability, an emotion is blazingly resonating with you, magnifying an aspect of your own soul, compelling you to dig deeper. This may be your one and only shot.
You're at a loss for words? You were so forceful earlier, but now that it's about you, you've got nothing to say?
I see now—this isn't a conversation at all. It's a top-down <color=#fb9259>test</color>.
Both the allure and the threats you've thrown my way are the will of Paradeisos, aren't they? This is the final <color=#fb9259>loyalty test</color>, isn't it, Envoy?

She locks eyes with you, unflinchingly silent. Gradually, you sense a nebulous wave of emotions coming to the surface—regret and sorrow, yet also relief, satisfaction, and a form of resolve. The complexity leaves you wondering for a moment if it's all just an illusion.

For a long moment, she smiles. Her hand, which had been cradling your cheek, gradually loosens its grip, as does the force with which you were holding her wrist. Emotions dissipate as quickly as they have surged, becoming an illusion before you can even make sense of them.
She takes a step back, resuming the poise of an elegant but detached doll, and maintains a calculated distance from you. The only trace left of your tense confrontation is a red mark on her wrist.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So you've seen through me.
She smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: All of this was a test set by Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Will you give me your answer now?
The rift has sealed, and in this moment, she finally gives you a clear answer.
The woman who once claimed to be a friend from your past has vanished. All that remains before you is an envoy from Paradeisos, here to conduct your final test.

In this moment, you vividly perceive a profound chasm between you—a divide she has always bridged. Now, with her retreat, you see it in stark clarity. This abyss isn't just a matter of perspectives or choices; it's a rift shaped by... time itself.

options: ...I think I understand you guys a bit now.

choices.text: ...I think I understand you guys a bit now.

steps.content: In your eyes, my problem isn't about what I've done or want to do; it stems from a <color=#fb9259>past</color> I'm completely unaware of. You fear it, and you fear me.
So there's really nothing left to discuss. You guard yourselves so vigilantly against me that you only trust what you can see.

But that's fine; my position remains unyielding. I'm committed to preserving my present with all my being. When it comes to the past, I see no reason the me of then would disapprove of the me I am now.
As long as he remains "me," I believe he would resonate with every arduous step I've taken.
steps.female_content: As long as she remains "me," I believe she would resonate with every arduous step I've taken.

steps.content: While it's unfortunate I couldn't hear any tales from an "old friend," I'll leave the quest for lost memories to my future self.
You take a pause. Everything is already decided; there's no more room for doubt. It's only now that I truly feel a tinge of regret.

options: Articulating this thought owes largely to you.

choices.text: Articulating this thought owes largely to you.

steps.content: Whether those words were lies or not, what you said during our first meeting had a profound impact on me. It's given me more assurance about the path I've traveled.
I only wish you were actually my friend—I'd love to know what's truly in your heart.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is that so... Do you really believe that...
Her eyes close partially as she loses herself in thought, then she lifts her gaze and offers a subdued smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're correct; I have nothing more to reveal. Henceforth, your conversations will be with Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Congratulations, the test has concluded. You've proven to be a person of true integrity and kindness.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos eagerly awaits this news. I shall take my leave from your Bureau; you no longer have to live in a state of anxiety.
Her words resonate more than ever as those of someone from Paradeisos, but her expression shifts to genuine sincerity.
It's as if she's bidding a heartfelt goodbye.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's good to see you again, and even better to see you happy.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Farewell.
The woman lifts her hand. You think she's offering a handshake and find yourself hesitating, unsure whether to reciprocate.

Instead, she gives you a gentle nudge, causing you to lose your balance and fall backward. Unbeknownst to you, the pale blue rift behind you has drawn closer. You plunge into it, landing in a sea of flowers that feels strangely familiar.
Bathed in the ethereal touch of myriad rays of light, you discern a hazy figure. Locked in its gaze, enfolded in its arms, in that fleeting union of minds, you catch glimpses of fractured memories.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: The data is recovering more quickly than anticipated. We're on the right track, and the experiment is proceeding smoothly.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: HUSH Project is advancing to Phase 3, time to bring in new elements.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: What's wrong?

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: Subject 17... She harbors intense animosity towards her overseers, evidenced by multiple incidents of assault during surveillance. Could her emotional volatility compromise the integrity of our experimental data? Should we consider replacing her?

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: A <color=#fb9259>Dissenter</color> among the Sinners, huh... Let's go ahead and use her for a trial run.

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: Subject is in place; confirm M-value fluctuations are within acceptable parameters. Commencing the final phase of Hush.

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: Initiating the extraction of Mania; entity formation underway, 20% complete.

steps.speaker: Pinned Monster
steps.content: Roarrrr!!

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: Channel confirmed open; initiate specialized intervention... Channel is stable; the experiment is now linked to the Corridor Zone.

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: Extraction phase complete; proceed with the activation of Rule Control Mechanism.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: Data has stabilized; positional anchor point secured. Stable link established between the Manic Entity and the test subject.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: Experiment successful; the outcome is flawless and potent, heralding an unparalleled stable point of observation. What shall we name it?

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: We'll name her <color=#fb9259>Rebel</color>, a fitting memorial to her former unruliness. We won't be seeing that defiant spirit again.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: She will surpass us in <color=#fb9259>marking</color> all Dissenters.

steps.speaker: Researchers
steps.content: Blessings upon you. Blessings upon you. Blessings upon you. May you witness the ultimate end.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Eclipse Operation has resulted in significant losses. The 6th Hush has prematurely reached its limits, and the recycling and destruction work has already commenced. In three days, you'll step into her role. Your new designation will be <color=#fb9259>Hush-X</color>, and you will inherit the Second Observatoriumas well as the No. 2 Schorl.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The No. 2 Schorl is deeply anchored in Rebel. All observation data will be automatically synchronized and collected. This energy will be converted into the power of the Schorl itself. Commands will be relayed to you through the Schorl by the Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: 90% of your time will be dedicated to observation. During exceptional periods, unique tasks will be assigned and you'll be awakened for them. Rest assured, your stability is our highest priority. Schorl will continually ensure this.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The marking ability has also been successfully implanted. Given the high stakes and resource consumption involved, the majority of Sinners will be shackled. The power will only be unleashed on exceptionally valuable <color=#fb9259>Dissenters</color>. Paradeisos needs more reliable tools, through you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Immediately sync all existing data. We've received a distress call from Nirvana: the mining facility in Inner Bay has gone rogue. They're requesting assistance from Paradeisos. This could also be an opportunity... Paradeisos is keen to discover the true nature of xxx within the Lone Island base and what the Underground intends to do with it.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is your mandate. For your inaugural observation mission, seek out the <color=#fb9259>Ultimate Answer</color>, and identify pathways for us.
....Copy that.

Across the rift, the woman's delicate silhouette recedes into the distance, leaving behind a tumult of emotions forever imprisoned in this floral expanse. It remains ambiguous as to who, among the two torn asunder, is the true captive.
You wrestle with the urge to call out—only to realize you've forgotten the name that should escape your lips…
As the light pulses, its luminescent blue hue drowns out the crimson glare and the monster's ferocious roar, expelling you entirely from this realm.
Chief, Chief!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are you alright? You passed out for 4 hours... Are you feeling unwell?

options: ...What just happened? Who was here a moment ago...

choices.text: ...What just happened? Who was here a moment ago...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The inspector is already en route back to Paradeisos. Ms. Shalom left a specific verbal message: The test has concluded, and Paradeisos is highly satisfied—you've met our expectations.
Nightingale visibly exhales, relieved. It's clear that Shalom's departure has lightened her mood considerably. A lot must have happened.
...What happened? It feels like you've just woken up from a nap, and your eyes are somewhat dry.
Shalom... who is she?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhhh! Big dummy, you finally decided to wake up, huh? Do you have any idea how worried I've been?
The Sinners burst in, interrupting your train of thought.
...Maybe ask later; it doesn't seem that important right now.

Shalom opens her eyes, weary and drained. Schorl has been by her side for a while now, its glow pulsing—both awaiting her answer and scrutinizing her intently. This must be a Level 4 alert. Had she taken any actions just now, she would have awoken to find the entire area reduced to rubble.
The Hush stands up, a smile gracing her lips. Even though the observed findings are already in sync, vocalizing them serves as a good icebreaker for the discussion ahead.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Investigation complete. The target has ingested at least <color=#fb9259>3</color> fragments: a full activation from BR-004, a semi-activated entity from BR-001, and an inert, restricted version from the White Cube. It seems the Underground has already made contact with him.
steps.female_content: Investigation complete. The target has ingested at least 3 fragments: a full activation from BR-004, a semi-activated entity from BR-001, and an inert, restricted version from the White Cube. It seems the Underground has already made contact with her.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...We've hit a historical threshold with these numbers. Based on <color=#fb9259>prior data</color>, this container's on the verge of failure.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's even more critical considering it's defective.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: What's the Hush's take on this? Is the risk too great? Should we destroy it immediately?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I don't think it's necessary. He's more stable than any subject we've had before. The absorption of Corpus and link with the Sinners hasn't tainted him severely.
steps.female_content: I don't think it's necessary. She's more stable than any subject we've had before. The absorption of Corpus and link with the Sinners hasn't tainted her severely.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Perhaps it's tied to his unique past. Even though he's the final flawed specimen, his stability is remarkable. I'll sync the data accordingly.
steps.female_content: Perhaps it's tied to her unique past. Even though she's the final flawed specimen, her stability is remarkable. I'll sync the data accordingly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Got it.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: So, before our next action against the ring, let's activate the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> within him. All associated risks have been communicated to Paradeisos.
steps.female_content: So, before our next action against the ring, let's activate the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> within her. All associated risks have been communicated to Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If that Rule ends up annihilating the subject, well, that's a hard pill to swallow. It just goes to show, some things are better left untouched by human hands.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Next, we'll continue to enhance the Hush's capabilities. By the eighth or, at the latest, the ninth generation, they should have full <color=#fb9259>marking</color> capabilities. At that point, they could also take on the duty of detaining the Sinners.
With an unreadable expression, Shalom slips into her coat and trails behind Schorl as they exit the lounge.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This is a reasonable judgment; I have no objections.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You've done an excellent job, X. Your performance has consistently been outstanding.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Interacting with him has drained me. Please allow me some time to recover.
steps.female_content: ...Interacting with her has drained me. Please allow me some time to recover.

steps.content: You won't be seen as an enemy... You'll be seen merely as a tool.
A tool that's unstable, unreliable, and can be sacrificed for various "necessities" at any given moment.
When the time comes, it might be me who takes action.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: New irregular activity has been detected at the BR-004 ruins, confirmed to originate from Corpus 02, dormant for the past 9 years.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: As we suspected, following X's observations, BR-002 was never fully neutralized. Corpus 02 has gained new <color=#fb9259>invisible capabilities</color>, and its risk level has now surpassed acceptable limits.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Any movements from the Underground? Their Shepherd failed to fully consume BR-002 in N.F.104; now, the enemy could resurface. She's always had a penchant for Corpus 02.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: The 9th Agency has reported increased enemy activity, but their motives are still a mystery. If the Underground Shepherd truly surfaces, she must be stopped. We can't risk letting her grow more powerful; the stakes are simply too high.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: How's the M-value looking in the West District? And what's the likelihood of another Black Ring incident triggered by Corpus 02?

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: The city council made a grave error when they passed the West District Order Management Regulations. It wasn't reason that guided them, but a crime fueled by selfish motives.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Are you suggesting we initiate the <color=#fb9259>Purge Order</color>?

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: How else can we mitigate these risks? This marks the second major incident involving the Black Ring in the West District within a year. First, it was the gang activities, and now we have Rustfire. Given our current management resources, we can't stamp out the Underground issues plaguing the West District. It's becoming a fertile ground for the Black Ring's Underground operations.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Representatives from Eastside and several Paradeisos members have submitted another petition. They're deeply concerned about the deteriorating situation in the West District and hope to prevent an even larger catastrophe...

The West District has a total population of 6.5 million, with fewer than 300,000 involved in gang violence. Fewer than 100,000 people could trigger the Black Ring, and fewer than 200,000 might be affected by its radiation.

The extra costs you're willing to pay to sidestep what you call risks, and the impending damage you're poised to inflict, have both already outstripped the harm from the Black Ring you claim to despise.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Activating the Purge Order now is within the Executive Committee's capabilities. When viewed from the angle of minimizing sacrifices, it's also the most manageable approach.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Indeed, there's no need for concern about the population. The overall populace is remarkably stable, presenting an opportunity to elevate our city-state's standards.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: A sacrifice of this magnitude is within the realm of acceptable losses. The real issue is...

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: For unknown reasons, Corpus 02 has developed extraordinary stealth capabilities. While it remains in the West District—or anywhere in the city-state, for that matter—nothing is predictable.
Accustomed to self-hypnosis through acts of sacrifice, convincing ourselves that everything we do holds greater value... The sunk costs only deepen our entrenchment in our own perspectives.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Time is running out, the stakes are too high. We can't allow the Underground force to continue to gain strength. We have no idea how close that Shepherd is to the Source…
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: ...For the sake of humanity, to stand against our gravest enemy, we must heed reason. It's the only way.

You've inherited nothing but the sterile logic and coldness of rational thought, yet both your origin and your aims have been compromised by fear. It's this paralyzing dread of risk that stifles any chance of a breakthrough.
Naturally, I would never voice these thoughts. Instruments don't question directives; setting off a Level 6 alert would be catastrophic. A Hush can't afford such pointless blunders.
She raises her hand and emotionlessly taps the outer wall of Schorl with her index finger. Schorl vibrated, initiating a Level 1 Scan, and scanned the Hush from head to toe.

This is the lowest level of irrational, meaningless action. Not long ago, Shalom started employing this little tactic for risk assessment. Now, it's just a game she plays to pass the time—although even the subject of her amusement is rather uninteresting.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...You're an exceptional Hush, X. The next time you find yourself deep in thought, try to rectify such purposeless physical tendencies; they could trigger system errors.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Initial discussions have concluded. We're aligned on using the West District Purge Order as our primary strategy, based on the precondition of preventing the Black Ring outbreak from sustaining the Underground Shepherd. Let's now move on to confirm the specifics.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The situation with Rustfire has intensified. Given the various risks involved, a straightforward approach to the purge operation is not viable. X, this is a multi-faceted operation; Paradeisos requires you to conduct a risk assessment for each variable. Make every effort to prevent the resurgence of BR-002 and ensure the successful implementation of the Purge Order.


<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Additionally, on March 16th, the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> on SHP-13 activated autonomously for the first time, taking place at the Drifter Camp in Inner Bay. SHP-13 encountered the invisible Corpus 02, and the situation has escalated to uncontrollable risk levels. Hence, you are assigned a secondary mission.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Maintain surveillance using Rebel. Schorl will determine the optimal timing for their encounter. Paradeisos will enforce the Rules to its fullest extent to eradicate both SHP-13 and the BR-002 Corpus. Regrettably, as an asset on the verge of becoming defective, this is his final and greatest utility.
steps.female_content: <color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Maintain surveillance using Rebel. Schorl will determine the optimal timing for their encounter. Paradeisos will enforce the Rules to its fullest extent to eradicate both SHP-13 and the BR-002 Corpus. Regrettably, as an asset on the verge of becoming defective, this is her final and greatest utility.

steps.content: Just as I suspected... I'm the one to go.
That makes things easier...
She bursts into laughter, making Schorl hover a few centimeters higher mechanically. HUSH-X now showing pointless emotions, Schorl initiates a Level 3 scan.
Shalom allows its chilling blue light to scan her from head to toe as she tunes into the channel.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Understood. Understood. Given the high stakes of this complex operation, let me first confirm what’s required.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Whether we're taking down the foundation of the Black Ring to enact the Purge Order or employing SHP-13 to eliminate Corpus 02, our objective remains the same: to prevent the resurgence of BR-002.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: So the crux of stopping BR-002's resurgence is to confront Paradeisos's most formidable threat—the Underground Shepherd, sparing no expense. Is that accurate?


<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Precisely.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I doubt the cost sits well with you. What's your strategy for "fine-tuning" this time?

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Expense is a secondary concern; Paradeisos's needs take precedence. The cost, including enacting the Purge Order, is justified to neutralize the Shepherd threat.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Still, constantly playing defense means we'll never seize control. This isn't the last we'll see of the Black Ring. Their knack for staying hidden keeps us perpetually at a disadvantage.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: That said, now's our chance to experiment with a bolder, yet effective strategy.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: Let's catalyze the explosion of BR-002, turning it into the ultimate lure for the Underground Shepherd—then we annihilate her.

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: I'll handle the nitty-gritty; no extra support or costs needed. All Paradeisos has to do is confirm one thing:

<color=#fb9259>X</color>: <color=#fb9259>Is eliminating the Underground Shepard</color> genuinely aligned with your objectives?

<color=#fb9259>??-All</color>: ...
Alright, employ the unassailable logic you so trust to address those pathetic, laughable fears, and devise an irresistible solution. In the end...
fulfill my purpose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I'm asking is, <color=#fb9259>what do you want</color>?
What do I want? You, of course.
It's good to see you haven't lost your edge. If your past self were here, he'd be just as relieved as I am.
steps.female_content: It's good to see you haven't lost your edge. If your past self were here, she'd be just as relieved as I am.

steps.content: She gazes down the other end of the channel, at the faceless operators of the Hushes who claim to be righteous.
I have six months left; let's find the Ultimate Answer.
